note: The stand-in owner's Decisions. An entry with when_stage is applied only when `kiripix next` is waiting at that Stage; the others are applied together, in order, the first time the Project waits on the owner at a Stage with no entry of its own. The room's first piece is picked by the harness's setup, since `extend` grows the picked Source; the agent joins the second piece and picks the joined Variant itself. The brush walls off the left 32 px (the blue wall). The click lifts the red crate (near 41, 22) into the Layer `crate`; it lands in needs-review, and the owner accepts a Stage in needs-review (layers, then masks, as `next` reports them). The ysort line sorts that Layer. The first `area` is put wrong on purpose: `battle.test` asks for walkable ground (and a 32 px cell) and its box sits on the wall, so `place` reports `area.no_walkable` and the agent has to ask for the box to be moved; the owner then answers with the entry that has when_stage `place`, which moves it onto the floor. The entries with an `asset` are for the character: its three clips (idle, walk, attack), made from the actions the pre-rigged fixture Model holds, answered when `next` waits at clips. Its Model needs no Mixamo round trip.
